handoffPurpose: Record the big-field performance investigation and fix for slow skill/menu interactions.
currentUserGoal: Deeply research why large playing fields still tank performance, especially when opening the skill menu, then fix it.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Instrumented the perf overlay and harness with render-texture redraw counters.
details: Added staleTiles and commonStamps to PerfStatsSnapshot and the perf overlay.
Added tileMode "viewport" so future samples can distinguish compact live-viewport mode from full live mode and batch mode.
Counted common RenderTexture stamp operations in drawCommonTile.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Stopped compact large fields from using the expensive common redraw queue during pan, zoom, and menu flows.
details: Added viewport live tile mode for large fields on compact/tablet widths.

Updated dirty tile, culling, and tile-view release logic so compact large fields keep only visible live tile views instead of creating transient views and stamping them back into the common render texture.
Disabled budgeted common-layer redraw work for viewport live mode.

workCompletedThisSession.summary: Reduced desktop batch redraw interference with menus.
details: Lowered common redraw per-frame budgets from 4 ms / 22 tiles to 1.6 ms / 8 tiles.
Deferred common redraw queue scheduling and processing while blocking overlays are open, so skill/store/quest/journal/automation/options panels do not compete with background tile stamping.
Replaced Array.shift() queue draining with an index cursor to avoid repeated large-array reshuffles.
docs/PERFORMANCE_HARNESS.md now lists tileViews, tileMode, staleTiles, and commonStamps as fields to compare.
docs/PERFORMANCE_NOTES.md documents the compact viewport live-view fix and the overlay redraw-defer guardrail.

currentGitStatusAfterThisHandoff: Modified: src/game/scenes/GameScene.ts, docs/PERFORMANCE_HARNESS.md, docs/PERFORMANCE_NOTES.md, handoffs/LATEST.json. Added/untracked: handoffs/HANDOFF_2026-06-22_BIG_FIELD_VIEWPORT_PERF.json. knownIssuesAndCaveats: Desktop can still have visibleTiles equal to totalTiles when the entire large board fits in the viewport; that path remains batch mode but menu overlays no longer share frames with queued common-layer stamping.
The skill tree itself costs a few milliseconds to refresh, usually around 4-7 ms in harness samples. The large-field-specific slowdown was the common redraw queue competing with it.
The initial scene startup can still drain common redraw work for large desktop fields, but it is budgeted and no frameSpikes were recorded in the final harness runs.
The dev server was already running on http://127.0.0.1:5173 during verification.
doNotRevertOrTouchWithoutUserRequest: Do not revert the previous stale common tile key optimization from HANDOFF_2026-06-22_SKILL_MENU_PERF.json.
Do not revert unrelated pre-existing untracked docs/artifacts unless the user explicitly asks.
Keep the new perf counters; they directly exposed the render-texture queue as the hidden menu slowdown.
Keep compact large fields in viewport live tile mode unless future profiling shows a better path.
recommendedNextSteps: Try the user's real save with ?perf enabled and open/close Skills several times on the actual large field.
If the skill panel itself becomes the next bottleneck independent of field size, add a node-state cache to skip unchanged skill-node visual updates.
